description: This file implements the PasswordValidationPolicyReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve password validation policies from the database, including all policies and the active one.

classes.name: PasswordValidationPolicyReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing password validation policy retrieval operations, utilizing JDBC for database interactions.

classes.name: PasswordValidationPolicyMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to convert ResultSet rows into PasswordValidationPolicyData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of all password validation policies from the database.

methods.name: retrieveActiveValidationPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active password validation policy; throws exception if none found.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a single row of ResultSet to a PasswordValidationPolicyData object.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Constructs the SQL schema string for querying password validation policies.
